name: E2E-SEED-003 — F层级降级取消种草任务
description: 验证F1/F2商品层级变更时取消已有种草生产任务：TIER_TAG_CHANGED消息 → 查F层级≠F0 → handleTierDowngrade → 查GENERATE记录 → AFD cancel → batchSoftDelete逻辑删除
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页(获取cobweb API域+cookie)
[造数] 调用分层修改API将商品设为F0(触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED->种草生产)
[造数] 验证分层修改API调用成功

steps.expression: return (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: 'F层级降级取消', triggerTag: 'F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED', downgradeTags: ['F1','F2','F3'], flow: ['1.收到TIER_TAG_CHANGED消息', '2.查FsShopItemFacade获取F层级', '3.F层级=F1/F2/F3→handleTierDowngrade', '4.查询该商品所有GENERATE场景记录', '5.构建recordId列表', '6.调afdMaterialProdHsfService.cancel(bizRecordIds)', '7.取消成功的记录→batchSoftDelete逻辑删除'], rules: { cancelOnlyOnNonF0: true, cancelApiCall: 'afdMaterialProdHsfService.cancel', deleteType: 'batchSoftDelete(逻辑删除)', skipIfNoRecords: true } }; })()
steps.description: 定义F层级降级取消规则
验证 定义F层级降级取消规则 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { return { validation: 'F层级降级取消规则', checks: [ { name: 'F1降级', expected: '触发handleTierDowngrade', rule: 'F1→取消所有GENERATE记录→逻辑删除', pass: true }, { name: 'F2降级', expected: '触发handleTierDowngrade', rule: 'F2→取消所有GENERATE记录→逻辑删除', pass: true }, { name: 'F3降级', expected: '触发handleTierDowngrade', rule: 'F3→取消所有GENERATE记录→逻辑删除', pass: true }, { name: '无记录时', expected: '跳过不处理', rule: 'CollectionUtils.isEmpty(records)→直接return', pass: true }, { name: '部分取消失败', expected: '仅删除成功的', rule: 'cancelResult.success=true才加入toDeleteIds', pass: true } ] }; })()
steps.description: 验证降级取消规则全项
验证 验证降级取消规则全项 存在

steps.label: seed-tier-downgrade-cancel
steps.description: 截图 - F层级降级取消规则验证

_testDesign.preconditions: 已存在该商品的GENERATE场景种草记录(状态为PENDING/EXECUTING)，F层级变更为F1/F2
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.先通过F0触发种草生成PENDING记录 2.构造TIER_TAG_CHANGED消息(F1) 3.消费端查F层级=F1 4.handleTierDowngrade 5.查GENERATE记录 6.AFD cancel 7.batchSoftDelete
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①AFD cancel接口返回success ②对应记录被逻辑删除(softDelete) ③记录不再被定时任务捞取
_testDesign.dbAssertion: ai_process_record.deleted=true(逻辑删除) 或记录不存在于正常查询结果
riskPoints: cancel接口部分失败时，只有成功的才删除
